title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the six qualities that invite success
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting six qualities-diligence, courage, patience, capacity for action, knowledge and valour. He emphasised that when these qualities are present in a person, even divine assistance is said to come to their aid. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “उद्यमः साहसं धैर्यं बुद्धिः शक्तिः पराक्रमः। षडेते यत्र वर्तन्ते तत्र दैवं सहायकृत्॥” The Subhashitam conveys that for the person who possesses these six qualities - diligence, courage, patience, the capacity for action, knowledge and valor - even God himself is present to offer assistance. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “उद्यमः साहसं धैर्यं बुद्धिः शक्तिः पराक्रमः। षडेते यत्र वर्तन्ते तत्र दैवं सहायकृत्॥” उद्यमः साहसं धैर्यं बुद्धिः शक्तिः पराक्रमः।

षडेते यत्र वर्तन्ते तत्र दैवं सहायकृत्॥ https://t.co/LTBPxDbYtG — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 29, 2026 *********** MJPS/SS/ST (Release ID: 2316334) Visitor Counter : 264 Read this release in: Manipuri , Gujarati , Malayalam
